rationale: The short thesis required a break below $25.04, but instead price rallied five straight 1m candles from $25.05 to $25.21 on rising volume, reclaiming the 9-EMA ($25.01) and grinding toward session VWAP ($25.25) with invalidation ($25.28) only ~$0.11 away. With momentum now against the position and the trigger level never hit, the setup is deteriorating, so I exit the small loss rather than ride into the automatic invalidation. A flip to long is unattractive given VWAP overhead resistance and a weak broad tape (SPY -1.11%).
